description: Korean commercial lease rent increase cap (상가건물 임대차보호법): converted deposit = deposit + monthly rent × 100; if within the regional limit (Seoul 900M, other overcrowding zones and Busan 690M, metropolitan cities etc. 540M, elsewhere 370M KRW) increases are capped at 5% of rent or deposit (시행령 제4조) and allowed once a year (제11조②); converting deposit to rent is capped at min(12%, base rate × 4.5) (시행령 제5조). Above the limit, renewal rights (10 years), opposability and key-money protection still apply (제10조의2).

baseRate.description: Bank of Korea base rate as a decimal (default 0.03)

monthsSinceLast.description: Months since the contract or the last increase

newMonthlyRent.description: Monthly rent the landlord asks for (KRW)

region.description: seoul; overcrowded = 과밀억제권역 outside Seoul and Busan; metro = metropolitan cities, Sejong, Paju, Hwaseong, Ansan, Yongin, Gimpo, Gwangju (Gyeonggi); other
